pageDescription: Craft CMS, Payload CMS and Next.js platform work for the Fidium Fiber family of websites.
fbOgSiteName: A Fort Worth based developer who makes unique web experiences.
workDescription: Fidium Fiber is a family of consumer, business, wholesale and partner websites for a fiber internet provider. At Amdocs I architected a headless Craft CMS with a bespoke content editor and page builder, custom modules and a GraphQL API that serves content to seven sites, then redesigned and shipped the Next.js applications on top of it. The platform work also included Payload CMS. I planned and drove the work from the first foundation to launch.
workHighlights: Built the headless Craft CMS (bespoke editor, GraphQL, custom modules) that serves content for 7 sites.
Redesigned and launched Next.js apps for Fidium Fiber, Business, Partners, Wholesale, Consolidated and fidium.net.
Maintained a shared UI toolkit of components, hooks and webhooks, tested with Jest and documented in Storybook.
Configured Nginx reverse proxies to serve several sites from one repo, across dev, QA, stage and production on GitLab CI/CD.
workRole: Software Engineer, Lead Craft CMS Developer
workTechnology: Craft CMS, Payload CMS, GraphQL, Next.js, React, Storybook, Jest, Nginx, Amazon Web Services (SES, S3, RDS)
